# Reading Logs
### How to Interprete Log File Generated by the Detector

*This manually is mostly written for Jeremy Taylor, likely the only one who will ever read this. XD*

## Help! Something Broke. (sys_logs)

If you're reading this, then something broke... sorry about that. Anyway, you came to the right place. 

Sys_logs holds exactly one log file per each time the FKW_detector is ran. Each log is titled as follows: 'process_control_{RPi_start_time}.log'. IMPORTANT: This datetime is a Raspberry Pi date time, not the WISPR datetime which is used when naming the dive logs and other data products.
